name: Automotive
description: Vehicle diagnostics and buses: CAN, K/L-line and J1850 signals, battery positive, and the OBD-II (SAE J1962) connector with its mandated pins; a generic sealed 3-way connector family with its crimp contacts, single-wire seals, cavity plug and crimp tool, and a sealed sensor lead. Device profiles for the resolver: a control unit sensor port and two 3-wire sensors with different pinouts, and a three-core sensor cable.
